How is my semantic skills vector computed?
We take your extracted skills (e.g. Python, NLP, PyTorch) and run them through a Sentence-Transformer model (dimension: 384). This generates a dense mathematical vector. We then calculate the cosine similarity between your resume vector and the target job description vector. High cosine alignment results in a higher ATS score.
